additional_info.body:
Dear Magnus,
Hope you are doing well.
We are continuously getting OCPP offline message on this charger and we have seen SIM card not inserted message for the same. Please plan site intervention with spare router and SIM to troubleshoot this issue.
There are 3 possible scenarios:
Data plan exhausted
: Please check the SIM data plan.
SIM card Faulty
: Carry one working SIM card with data plan to check this.
Router Faulty
: Carry one spare router if needed to replace.
Recommended Spare part MLFB: Router XF4 (
8EM5903-0AA01-3AA8)
and SIM card with data plan.

additional_info.subject: On site intervention.
additional_info.body: Customers electrian went on site and put some tape on the backside of the sim card. After this the router showed sim card inserted and the charger came online.
